title: Blackstone Real Estate Debt X
archetype: Side Letter MFN (Most Favored Nation) Election & Custom Fee Tier Routing
author: minh.nguyen

outcome.summary: Initial Closing held on 2026-02-06 as planned, after UAT sign-off slipped 3 days (2026-01-23 to 2026-01-26) while the tier evaluator was rebuilt on FX-normalized commitments and fund counsel confirmed the Section 2.3 conversion clause.

incident: On 2026-01-20 the side-letter regression suite showed Cayman Feeder commitments in EUR, GBP and AUD being tiered on their raw amounts. Nordhafen Pensionskasse (EUR 22,000,000 = US$25,630,000) got no MFN election workflow. Pennant Hill (GBP 38,000,000 = US$50,996,000) was routed to Tier 1 / Class B instead of Tier 2 / Class C. Wattlebrook (AUD 34,000,000 = US$22,712,000) was over-tiered into Tier 1 with MFN unlocked, which would have exposed the confidential MFN compendium to an ineligible LP. All three were caught in UAT before any live subscription was accepted.
rootCause: The v1 tier evaluator, inherited from USD-only funds, compared commitment.amount directly against USD thresholds with no currency dimension. The side-letter policy's conversion clause (Annex C Section 2.3) never became a requirement, so no rate source, fixing date or audit fields existed.
resolution: fx_mfn_tier_rules.json v2.0.0 converts each commitment at the pinned WM/Refinitiv 4:00 p.m. London fix for the London business day before submission. It rounds to whole USD before testing thresholds, aggregates affiliated commitments across both feeders, persists rate, fixing date and source, converts increases at their own fixing and never downgrades on FX alone. MFN electability is driven by side_letter_clause_matrix.csv, which maps Annex C Section 4.3 exclusions and a minimum tier for each clause.
reusableRules: Normalize every currency-denominated threshold to the fund currency at the contractually pinned rate and fixing date, never a live feed, and store the rate, fixing date and rate source with the subscription.
Turn the side-letter policy's FX clause (rate source, fixing date, rounding, fallback, amendments) into requirements at kickoff; if the documents are silent, have counsel specify it before UAT.
Derive fixing dates from the rate source's calendar and timezone (Europe/London for the WM/Refinitiv 4:00 p.m. fix), not from the server's or the investor's clock.
Round as the policy requires before testing a threshold, and fixture-test every threshold at plus or minus one unit in every permitted currency, including currencies weaker than USD that over-tier.

Aggregate affiliated commitments only after converting each one, re-tier the whole group on any subscription or amendment, convert increases at their own fixing, and never downgrade on FX movement alone.
Drive MFN electability from a clause matrix (minimum tier plus exclusion reason per clause), and lock the election workflow when an LP is not eligible.
